standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-coherence of the pushforward of a quasi-coherent module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, label spaces-morphisms-lemma-pushforward (invoked at proof line 3019)
standard_prerequisites.use: It shows that $p_*(M \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X)$ is quasi-coherent on $\Spec(A)$, so that the equality of global sections determines it as $\widetilde{M}$.

standard_prerequisites.name: Global sections of direct sums of the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-colimits (invoked at proof line 3022)
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives $\Gamma(X, \bigoplus_{i \in I}\mathcal{O}_X) = \bigoplus_{i \in I}A$, which is the free case of the claim.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of $H^1$ in the situation, which makes global sections right exact
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, Situation \ref{situation-vanishing} and the vanishing statement of the surrounding section (used at proof line 3025)
standard_prerequisites.use: It lets the global sections of a presentation of $M$ compute the global sections of $M \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X$.

core_obligations: Deduce $p_*(M \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X) = \widetilde{M}$ from the equality $\Gamma(X, M \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X) = M$, using that the pushforward is quasi-coherent on the affine base (proof lines 3016-3020).
Verify the free case: $\Gamma(X, \bigoplus_{i \in I}\mathcal{O}_X) = \bigoplus_{i \in I}A$ (proof lines 3021-3022).

For a general $M$, choose a presentation $F_1 \to F_0 \to M$ by free modules; since $H^1(X,-) = 0$ the global sections functor is right exact and so is the pullback $p^*$, so applying $\Gamma(X, - \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X)$ to the presentation yields the exact sequence computing $\Gamma(X, M \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X) = M$ (proof lines 3023-3033).
proof_roadmap: Pushforward from the equality of global sections (proof lines 3016-3020).
Presenting $M$ by free modules and using right exactness (proof lines 3023-3033).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes both the pushforward and the global sections of the pullback of an $A$-module along the structure morphism in the vanishing situation (statement lines 3008-3013). The proof first notes that the pushforward statement follows from the global sections statement because the pushforward is quasi-coherent on the affine base, then handles free modules through the known computation of global sections of direct sums, and finally presents a general module by free modules and uses the vanishing of $H^1$ together with right exactness of the pullback. The reduction to free modules through a presentation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
